author: Fresh-Depth-4717
body: E-San Rod-Sap in Anaheim. Fantastic Thai food. Outside looks questionable and it’s attached to a small grocery store.

author: Papeenie
body: A staple for me. Laos Thai. I love their little market and get things like krachai, namprik, bai magrut. I bought my food mortar and pestle here. The cold desserts in the fridge like Lod Chong is so good. Saku SaiMoo on weekends are done very well. I told the owners I’d pay them to teach me how to make it. My daughter always gets the raw shrimp salad and crispy rice salad, extra cilantro, ginger and lime. Pla Salid is also incredible here. Order them in pairs.
